special_abilities.name: Earth Glide
special_abilities.desc: The xorn can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the xorn doesn’t disturb the material it moves through.

special_abilities.name: Treasure Sense
special_abilities.desc: The xorn can pinpoint the location of precious metals and stones within 60 feet of itself.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The xorn makes one Bite attack and three Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) Slashing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Charge
bonus_actions.desc: The xorn moves up to its Speed or Burrow Speed straight toward an enemy it can sense. Zombies
